category_rows.name: Individually randomized trial
category_rows.definition: All five eligibility conditions met; individuals, families, couples, or dyads randomized

category_rows.name: Cluster randomized trial
category_rows.definition: All five conditions met; intact groups randomized (schools, clinics, agencies, communities)

category_rows.name: Quasi-experimental
category_rows.definition: Intervention delivered and compared, but allocation not random or never stated; includes single-arm designs

category_rows.name: Secondary analysis
category_rows.definition: Analysis of data from a trial conducted and reported elsewhere (moderator, mediator, subgroup, follow-up)

category_rows.name: Protocol or design
category_rows.definition: Protocol, registration, design, or baseline paper with no outcome results

category_rows.name: Review
category_rows.definition: Systematic review, meta-analysis, or scoping review, including reviews of trials

category_rows.name: Other
category_rows.definition: Observational, qualitative, theoretical, commentary, methods, instrument validation, and vignette or analog experiments
